title: Answer: time is relative change in space, a precondition for experience

statements.text: IWMT gives no physical theory of time. In experience, time is relative change within space and one of the categories a world model needs. The stream of experience may be a series of discrete estimates, and whether it is continuous is left open.

sources.quote: space (i.e., relative degrees of locality), time (i.e., relative changes within space)
